What's In The Box?1*16oz retro flowers coffee glass cup with a bamboo lid and straw1*HAPPY BIRTHDAY candle1*bath bomb1*flower hair clip1*silk scrunchie1 set of clay beaded bracelets1*paper cut happy birthday card1* cute box package with paper fillingRetro Daisy Flowers Coffee Glass Cup: This 16oz glass cup is decorated with charming daisy flower prints. Measuring 3.1 inches wide by 6.3 inches tall, it is crafted from thick, high-quality borosilicate glass, ensuring both transparency and durability. It is free from lead and BPA and comes complete with a bamboo lid and straw.Lavender Scented Happy Birthday Candle: This 100g/3.5oz soy wax candle offers up to 25 hours of burn time. With lovely printing, it is sure to brighten her day. The candle releases a long-lasting lavender fragrance, perfect for bath time, massage, reading, spa sessions, yoga, work, and rest.Bath Bomb: This 100g bath bomb features a cute round shape with stunning colors that will catch her eyes and please her senses.
Flower Claw Clip: Our claw clips for thick hair are made with high-quality ABS material, making them durable and not easily breakable. These newly designed fashion hair clips measure 7*4cm and each weighs over 21g. They are soft and lightweight, ensuring they won't burden your hair.Silk Hair Scrunchie: With a diameter of 5.7 inches, these hair ties are easy to use and hold your hair very well. They are ideal for thin, medium, and thick hair, and can also be used as a bracelet, serving as a stylish accessory for your wrist.Clay Beaded Bracelets: The inner perimeter of these bracelets is approximately 7 inches, making them suitable for most wrist sizes. The stackable beaded bracelets are made of premium soft clay, polymer, and acrylic material, with real gold plating. They are not easy to break, waterproof, durable, and lightweight.Paper Cut Happy Birthday Card: This elite design papercut birthday card is perfect for any age. It is laser-cut from beautiful, excellent quality pearlescent card. The card measures 5.9 inches by 5.9 inches, providing a premium touch to your birthday greetings.

items.label: What's In The Box
items.value: This thoughtfully curated gift set includes a 16oz retro flowers coffee glass cup with a bamboo lid and straw, a HAPPY BIRTHDAY candle, a bath bomb, a flower hair clip, a silk scrunchie, a set of clay beaded bracelets, a paper cut happy birthday card, and a cute box package with paper filling.

items.label: Happy Birthday Gift Box
items.value: Delight your mother, friend, significant other, teen girl, daughter, wife, or girlfriend with this beautifully curated birthday gift box. Unlike ordinary dollar store gifts, our box is filled with quality-crafted items she will use every day. Send her our happy birthday gift box to bring joy and celebrate her special day!

items.label: Cute Retro Daisy Flowers Coffee Glass Cup
items.value: The 16oz glass cup, decorated with charming daisy flower prints, adds a touch of nature to your morning coffee or afternoon tea. Measuring 3.1 inches wide by 6.3 inches tall, it is crafted from thick, high-quality borosilicate glass, ensuring both transparency and durability. It is free from lead and BPA and comes complete with a bamboo lid and straw.

items.label: Happy Birthday Candle & Bath Bomb
items.value: Enjoy approximately 25 hours of burn time with our handmade candle, crafted using premium soy wax and fragrant oils for a soothing lavender aroma. Our eco-friendly soy wax ensures a clean, sustainable burn. The included bath bomb enhances her fragrant and relaxed bath time.

items.label: Surprise Gift Box
items.value: All items are beautifully packaged in a high-quality gift basket box, ready for gifting with no need for repackaging. Our professional after-sales team is available to assist with any issues within 24 hours. If you encounter any problems, please email us. We are dedicated to ensuring customer satisfaction.
